description: This file defines the GCSBucketLogger class, which manages logging events to Google Cloud Storage buckets, including batching, object naming, and retrieval of request/response payloads. It also handles premium user validation and asynchronous log processing.

classes.name: GCSBucketLogger
classes.description: A logger class for batching and sending logs to Google Cloud Storage, with support for success/failure events, object naming, and payload retrieval.

methods.name: async_log_success_event
methods.description: Logs a successful event asynchronously by adding it to the queue.

methods.name: async_log_failure_event
methods.description: Logs a failed event asynchronously by adding it to the queue.

methods.name: async_send_batch
methods.description: Processes and sends all queued logs to GCS in batch.

methods.name: _get_object_name
methods.description: Generates the object name for a log entry based on payload and response.

methods.name: get_request_response_payload
methods.description: Retrieves request/response payload from GCS for a given request ID and time window.

methods.name: _generate_success_object_name
methods.description: Creates object name for successful logs.

methods.name: _generate_failure_object_name
methods.description: Creates object name for failure logs.

methods.name: _get_object_date_from_datetime
methods.description: Formats a datetime object into a date string.

methods.name: async_health_check
methods.description: Performs a health check on the GCS bucket (not implemented).
